verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows Fivetran moving data from applications, databases, event streams and files into a warehouse or data lake, plus in-warehouse transformations. Nothing documents syncing modeled warehouse data back into CRM, ads or support tools. The community comment comparing Fivetran (API to database) with Census (database to API) frames reverse ETL as another product's role. Data movement is a fair question for this kind of platform, so the absence of evidence makes this none rather than na.

support.subject: As an analytics engineer, I sync modeled warehouse data back into SaaS tools (CRM, ads, support) to activate it where teams work
